function.name: local.process_start
function.description: Execute a saved script by filename in absolute cwd. Save with script_patch in an earlier call. Extensions: .sh uses zsh, .py uses python3, .js/.mjs/.cjs use Bun. Optional args are literal strings. Each execution uses a private snapshot unaffected by later patches. No default timeout; optional timeoutMs terminates the process group when elapsed. Complete stdout/stderr are returned and persisted in stdoutPath/stderrPath. Returns processId immediately; use local.process_status, local.process_write and local.process_stop to interact.

timeoutMs.description: 可选执行时限（毫秒），省略则不设时限；到期终止进程组
